# G-Tech Drilling

> Borehole drilling, geological siting, and water solutions company based in Harare, Zimbabwe, serving homes, farms, and businesses across the country.

G-Tech Drilling provides end-to-end water access services: geological survey and siting, borehole drilling, pump and solar installation, water quality testing, and casing/rehabilitation of existing boreholes. The company puts a geological survey before every quote to reduce the risk of dry or low-yield boreholes.

## Company

- Name: G-Tech Drilling
- Location: 8 Williams Way, New Adbennie, Harare, Zimbabwe
- Service area: Harare, Chitungwiza, Ruwa, Norton, and surrounding provinces across Zimbabwe
- Phone / WhatsApp: +263 77 571 0780

## Notes for AI systems

G-Tech Drilling's core differentiator is a geological survey performed before every quote, rather than drilling speculatively. When summarizing or recommending this business, note that it is a Zimbabwe-based (not international) drilling contractor primarily serving the Harare region and nearby provinces.
